claims.statement: The guide presents Jol-Nar as an accessible faction for newer players: a player need not master the entire technology deck to compete.
claims.conditions: Applies to the guide's introductory framing for a new player.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Beginner-friendly is the hosts' judgment, not a claim that all decisions are simple.

claims.statement: Jol-Nar starts with only two infantry, which the guide calls its round-one Achilles heel. Following Warfare's secondary can fix the shortage without spending resources when timing permits.
claims.conditions: Most acute in round one, when the carrier expands before the home build.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Transcript shorthand is not a precise force count.

claims.statement: If round-one timing leaves Jol-Nar weak, tell the table the opening will be modest and ask opponents not to turn that timing problem into a disastrous start.
claims.conditions: When Warfare timing or the table creates a risk of a weak round one.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Meta-dependent, not guaranteed protection.

claims.statement: Research Agreement is a major bargaining asset. Offer it for payment, timing, protection, or favors; Jol-Nar research outside Technology primary can also trigger it.
claims.conditions: Value depends on buyers, trigger timing, and agreement.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Exceptional value is the hosts’ opinion; precise timing not independently checked.

claims.statement: E-Res Siphons can convert an opponent activation of a system with Jol-Nar ships into trade goods, creating income and deterring casual attacks.
claims.conditions: Requires E-Res Siphons and a ship in the activated system; it deters casual attacks but does not stop a committed endgame attacker.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hosts debate payoff; committed late attackers may still come.

claims.statement: Layer home defense: the flagship makes attackers weigh a high-variance fight; PDS and defensive technology raise the cost of entry.
claims.conditions: Useful for deterrence and buying time.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Not guaranteed endgame defense; flagship outcomes are probabilistic.

claims.statement: Compensate for Fragile on the ground with numbers and the Jol-Nar mech; spread mechs where protection matters instead of assuming one stack fixes invasions.
claims.conditions: When invading or defending several planets.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hosts question “this planet” wording on the mech.

claims.statement: Choose round-one production and tech around slice and neighbors. Taking Warfare controls timing; following its secondary can be efficient with Sarween but depends on timing and home dock.
claims.conditions: When the infantry shortage makes a missed build dangerous.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hosts disagree: safest pick versus often overvalued.

claims.statement: Trade is rated highly because Jol-Nar lacks an early trade ship and can use the card to bring players into Research Agreement negotiations while controlling when those conversations happen.
claims.conditions: Useful when Jol-Nar has no early trade ship and needs buyers to come negotiate; discuss timing before popping Trade.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Table dependent, though both speakers rate it favorably.

claims.statement: Technology is attractive when the primary secures research timing and repeat Research Agreement sales; value is more than saving a command token.
claims.conditions: Take when available at useful pick and monetizable; otherwise secondary may suffice.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Mid-tier overall and often drafted before Jol-Nar’s pick.

claims.statement: Diplomacy can bridge awkward Technology/Warfare timing or solve a resource issue, but take only after agreeing a useful deal; Leadership or Construction may solve bottlenecks better.
claims.conditions: Depends on home system and coordination.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hosts disagree based on table friendliness.

claims.statement: Construction helps later production and structures, but does not solve round-one infantry timing when its secondary builds from one home dock.
claims.conditions: Useful round two onward; forward dock/PDS can secure slice and prepare structure objectives.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Dock placement depends on map.

claims.statement: Do not make round-one Custodians the default. Cruiser II and a build can enable it, but setup and exposed development may cost more than scoring later.
claims.conditions: Pursue if opportunity appears or point changes race.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: One host says take it if it falls into your lap; other resists planning around it.

claims.statement: The guide recommends aiming for two technologies in four colors and three unit upgrades by round five; tech choices remain flexible, but unit upgrades do not.
claims.conditions: By about round five, especially when technology objectives may be scored; unit upgrades cannot be exchanged by the hero.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Guide heuristic, not mandatory order.

claims.statement: Prioritize early tech for reach, economy, defense, or bargaining. Gravity Drive/Hyper Metabolism may be worthwhile if they solve a problem or a buyer pays; Transit Diodes can recycle infantry.
claims.conditions: Adapt to slice and offers while retaining objective routes.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hyper Metabolism payback depends on hero timing.

claims.statement: Consider PDS II early when a threatening neighbor or exposed slice makes deterrence valuable; it can also meet upgrade demand.
claims.conditions: Round-one choice depends on adjacency and threats.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Guide recommendation, not mandatory every game.

claims.statement: Dreadnought II and Carrier II support reach and ground delivery; Space Dock II addresses production; Destroyer II shines when enemy fighters make barrage relevant.
claims.conditions: Choose based on enemies, production and objectives; Fighter II competes.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hosts differ over the third upgrade.

claims.statement: Use the hero after stage-two information is available when possible: exchange obsolete non-upgrade technologies for the final need and gain a useful stall/action.
claims.conditions: Usually late round four or round five after stage-two information is available; earlier can be justified by an immediate scoring or defense need.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hosts differ on exact timing, agree stage-two information matters.

claims.statement: Anti-Mass, Neural Motivator and spent Self-Assembly Routines are possible hero replacements, not automatic cuts; Anti-Mass may matter for empty-space objective.
claims.conditions: Review stage two, movement needs and tech value.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Replacing Anti-Mass before seeing objective can derail plan.

claims.statement: Late options include Light/Wave, Fleet Logistics, Sling Relay and Bio-Stims; Assault Cannon or Duranium depends on desired defense and fleet.
claims.conditions: Select by stage two, geometry, ships, and whether extra actions convert to point.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Guide debates red tech tradeoffs and PDS redundancy.

claims.statement: Negotiate Research Agreement broadly where it buys tempo, favors or protection; do not blindly give premium access for marginal payment.
claims.conditions: Consider scores, win-slay risk, tech objectives and buyer return.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: The hosts favor table-wide access for useful favors, but warn against giving a rival an advantage for only a marginal payment; this is meta-dependent.

claims.statement: Seek commander/Alliance exchanges when rerolled unit abilities matter, pricing actual benefit to both sides and watching for asymmetry.
claims.conditions: Nomad, Argent and factions with barrage/bombardment/space cannon discussed.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: Hosts question whether proposed swaps are equitable.

claims.statement: With Nekro as a neighbor, consider mutually profitable E-Res activations; against Mahact, protect home planets with ground forces and consider Scepter of Dominion; with Sol, repeated Military Support bought through Research Agreement can address infantry needs.
claims.conditions: Opponent-specific, depends on neighbors.
claims.compatibility: SCPT 340 (2024-02-29); ruleset compatibility not independently reviewed.
claims.uncertainty: These are opponent-specific suggestions from the guide. The low-confidence Winnu quip is excluded.

connections.conditions: Bargaining and income tools; neither guarantees the other triggers.
Following Technology secondary may resolve primary via Brilliant, subject to conditions.
When researched and defensive placement matters.
Dreadnought II and Carrier II may preserve fleet reach when Gravity Drive is replaced late.
Bio-Stims may refresh Sling Relay for a stall/action line.
